value.note: As a War Mage you gain the War Magic feature and the Shield Block feat at 1st level, become trained in light and medium armor (expert in light armor, medium armor and unarmored defense at 11th), treat martial weapons as simple weapons for proficiency, and must choose the School of Battle Magic as your arcane school; you never gain Arcane Bond, Arcane Thesis, or Defensive Robes, and you must take War Mage Dedication as your 2nd-level class feat.

As a Vindicator you follow a deity and gain its sanctification, you're trained in Religion instead of Nature and in your deity's favored weapon (using your martial proficiency if it's an advanced weapon, and gaining Deadly Simplicity if it's a simple weapon or unarmed attack with a damage die smaller than d6), you must take the vindication edge as your hunter's edge, and you learn warden spells as divine spells cast with Wisdom; you must take Vindicator Dedication as your 2nd-level class feat.

options.label: Critical Blast junction

options.label: Impulse junction
options.note: Adds that element's Single Gate impulse benefit when you use an impulse of that element costing 2 or more actions. Only one impulse junction per round.

options.label: Aura junction
options.note: Adds that element's effect to your kinetic aura when you Channel Elements — an in-play effect, not a persistent sheet bonus.

options.note: Resistance equal to your level against poison damage and against damage from creatures or effects with the wood trait, while your kinetic aura is active. At 17th level you also gain immunity to wood-trait effects.

value.note: Warrior of Legend (fighter only): you don't gain Shield Block and aren't trained in heavy armor, you're trained in both Acrobatics and Athletics, you gain Diehard plus a cursed weakness (half your level, minimum 1) to one physical damage type you choose — becoming doomed 2 when it damages you — and your fighter weapon mastery and weapon legend can only improve spears and polearms.

value.prompt: Choose your arcane innate spell (1/day, heightened to half your level rounded up)

value.note: You don't pick a normal investigator methodology — you have the esoterica methodology instead: trained in Occultism or Religion, the Quick Identification skill feat, one common divine cantrip and one common occult cantrip as at-will innate spells, and trained spell attack rolls and spell DCs using Intelligence.

value.prompt: Choose your sin — you add its spells to your curriculum, gain its initial school spell, and take on its anathema

options.label: Envy — Cutting Eye
options.note: The Cutting Eye reveals and creates weakness. Anathema: using your magic to cause harm with the elements or void. Curriculum gains the envy sin spells (Enfeeble, Dispel Magic, Spellwrack, Detonate Magic…).

options.label: Gluttony — All-Encompassing Hunger
options.note: The All-Encompassing consumes without end. Anathema: using your magic to protect others or manipulate minds. Curriculum gains the gluttony sin spells (Grim Tendrils, Vampiric Feast, Devouring Void, Massacre…).

options.label: Greed — Precious Gleam
options.note: The Precious Gleam hoards resources and reshapes forms. Anathema: using your magic to affect the mind or perception rather than physical reality. Curriculum gains the greed sin spells (Enlarge, Shape Stone, Dragon Form, Petrify…).

options.label: Lust — Heart's Hook
options.note: The Heart's Hook drowns reason in desire. Anathema: using your magic to meddle with physical forms or invoke the void. Curriculum gains the lust sin spells (Charm, Enthrall, Dominate, Telepathic Demand…).

options.label: Pride — Crescent Scepter
options.note: The Crescent Scepter insists on its own superiority. Anathema: using your magic to change or create physical things rather than their appearances. Curriculum gains the pride sin spells (Illusory Disguise, Mirage, Project Image, Overwhelming Presence…).

options.label: Sloth — Reclined Apport
options.note: The Reclined cuts away every drudgery. Anathema: using your magic to manipulate appearances or directly cause harm with the elements. Curriculum gains the sloth sin spells (Sleep, Slow, Translocate, Resplendent Mansion…).

options.label: Wrath — Vengeful Glare
options.note: The Vengeful Glare answers problems directly. Anathema: using your magic to protect or create. Curriculum gains the wrath sin spells (Force Barrage, Fireball, Wall of Fire, Falling Stars…).

value.prompt: Store items in the sleeves or the train?
value.note: The same daily preparations also pick WHICH suit of fine clothing is enchanted (Hardness +level, HP +2x level, ends if a new set is prepared); only the storage location is a closed list, so the garment itself is left unwired.

value.prompt: Which apparition manifests as your familiar?
value.note: The legal answers are the apparitions attuned this morning; there is no apparition filter available in `from`, so this is free text. Leave blank on days you don't manifest a familiar.

value.prompt: Which claimed domain is active today?
value.note: Legal answers are the domains this character has claimed (up to four); no domain filter exists in `from`, so this is free text. A Mythic Point can switch the active domain mid-day, and the retained domain after an overcharge lasts until the next daily preparations.

value.prompt: Which property rune does your bond add?
value.note: Any common weapon property rune of your level or lower (or one you have access to) — it need NOT be a rune you own, and `from` has no rune content filter, so this is free text; it counts against the weapon's property rune limit.

value.prompt: Blessed Armament property rune?
value.note: You can also move the spirit to a different weapon or handwraps during daily preparations.

value.prompt: Pelt attuned damage type?
Spell inscribed on the robes?
value.note: Using this ability erases any scroll already inscribed on the robe.

value.prompt: Lore skill granted by The Queen Mother?
value.note: Must be a Lore skill in which you have no proficiency.

value.prompt: School spell
Shift an armor rune into which rune?
value.note: Suppresses one existing property rune on a suit of armor you carry until your next daily preparations; the armor must meet the temporary rune's prerequisites, and any rune that required the suppressed one is suppressed too.

value.prompt: Shift a weapon rune into which rune?
value.note: Suppresses one existing property rune on a weapon you carry until your next daily preparations; the weapon must meet the temporary rune's prerequisites, and any rune that required the suppressed one is suppressed too.

value.prompt: Which repertoire spell do you swap out today?
value.note: Until your next daily preparations it is replaced by another spell of the same rank from your tradition, which you track yourself. Spells granted specifically by your bloodline can't be swapped out.

value.prompt: Which 1st-rank spell fills your wayfinder?
value.note: Cast it from the wayfinder using the spell's normal actions; once expended it can't be restocked until your next daily preparations.

value.prompt: Which weapon is your staff fused into?
value.note: The fusion lasts until your next daily preparations, though you can spend 10 minutes to meld the staff into a different weapon. The pair shares whichever weapon potency and striking rune is higher level. Staves are stored as weapons here, so choose the weapon, not the staff.

value.prompt: Which evolution feat for your eidolon?
value.note: Your eidolon gains the chosen evolution feat until your next daily preparations.

value.prompt: Bonded beast gun today (one you've performed a ritual hunt with)
value.note: Must be a beast gun you own and have previously performed a ritual hunt with. Recorded as free text because no beast gun items exist in the app's data, same as Call Gun's bonded weapon.

value.prompt: Which blank item did you invest?
value.note: A blank paper, journal, badge, or similar item used to display authority. Only works while you hold it.

value.prompt: Familiar's element today (only an element of your own kinetic gate)
value.note: You can only change the familiar's element if you have more than one kinetic element, and only to an element of your own kinetic gate — the list is not filtered to your gate.

value.prompt: Today's spell from your book of occult spells
value.note: Any one spell written in your book of occult spells (your repertoire plus spells you've Learned with Occultism). Already in your repertoire = an extra signature spell today; otherwise treat it as in your repertoire until your next daily preparations. The app doesn't model the occult book, so the spell is recorded by name.

value.prompt: Who is your charge today?
value.note: The link — awareness of the creature and 30-foot touch-range spellcasting — lasts until your next daily preparations. Leave a dash if you don't designate one today.

value.prompt: Revelation spell for today?
value.note: Domain spells and revelation spells are both listed. Pick a basic or advanced domain spell from a domain you have access to, or an initial or advanced revelation spell from a mystery OTHER than your own — the app can't check domain access or which mystery is yours.

value.prompt: Alchemical food to preserve?
value.note: Name the infused alchemical food you made with advanced alchemy; it won't expire at your next daily preparations. You can preserve 2 items if you're an expert in Crafting or Cooking Lore, 3 if master, 5 if legendary — list the extras here as well. Preserving a new item spoils the oldest.

value.prompt: Which ikon feat do you gain today?
value.note: Any ikon feat of 16th level or lower, whether or not you already have it. You only gain its benefits if you meet its prerequisites — that is not checked here.

value.prompt: Which spell your familiar knows do you lend?
value.note: Any spell your familiar knows, of no higher a rank than the highest rank of spells you can cast −2. Which of your charges receives it is an ally choice and isn't tracked here.

value.prompt: Which weapon carries your celestial blessing?
value.note: Handwraps of Mighty Blows are listed here with your weapons. A pre-statted handwraps bundle (+1 striking and the like) is recorded as worn equipment and won't appear — select the plain Handwraps you etch your runes onto.

value.prompt: Rune today (on one weapon or handwraps you choose)
value.note: The rune lasts 24 hours or until your next daily preparations and doesn't count against the weapon's maximum rune count.

value.prompt: Kind of demon hunted today
value.note: Any specific demon (succubus, omox, shemhazian, Treerazer...). The first melee Strike that hits one of them each round deals +1d6 spirit damage (2d6 at 13th, 3d6 at 17th).

value.prompt: Your charge today
value.note: Name the ally you've sworn to protect; your Taunt penalty against enemies rises to -2 for your charge. You can take 10 minutes to change your charge before your next daily preparations.

value.prompt: Spear or polearm infused today
value.note: The list shows every weapon you carry - choose a spear or polearm. It gains the animated rune, which doesn't count against its maximum property runes.

value.prompt: Warshard weapon today (expert proficiency; not intelligent or an artifact)
value.note: The list shows every weapon you carry; the proficiency and intelligent/artifact limits aren't checked here. Only one warshard weapon at a time.

value.prompt: Warshard material today (type none to skip)
value.note: Optional. The material and its grade must be your level or lower; standard grade needs a level 9+ weapon, high grade a level 15+ weapon.

value.prompt: Extra warshard rune today (common, your level or lower; type none to skip)
value.note: Typed by hand - the app has no list of weapon property runes to pick from. The rune ignores the weapon's maximum property runes, and is dormant unless you wield your warshard weapon with at least 1 unspent Mythic Point.
